releaseNotes:
v1.0.0

Rooms
- Companion follows the restored (active) room only.
- Minimize: Room Console is cleared, Companion pauses, and a Room Minimized overlay stays up until you restore. Restore resumes and fills the console from the live room.
- Another room becomes active: Companion stops (press Start yourself). Focus moves to that room. Closing a minimized room no longer leaves the old user list stuck on the new room.
- Activity log: Entered / Minimized / Exited room-### | room name.

Presets
- Attach a preset to a room-###. Entering or restoring that room switches to the preset automatically.
- Export and import include the attached room id.
- Preset manager: one-line names (21 characters), attach-to-room fields, delete confirm uses CANCEL.

Direct messages
- Direct (DM) from Room Console and from Message Recorder, including users who are not in the room.
- Send DM uses IMVU native conversations. You can reply from recorded messages at any time, from any place.
